regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal is the lone clear leader (score 1.095, eligible, but mean-revert-tagged and mid-durability 0.54), with Banks the only other eligible theme and already crowded (z 1.74). Crucially, gate_helps is false on China A-shares history — the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown here — and the detector's own direction accuracy is only 0.337, so ALL leans must be low-conviction, conditional, and humble.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks' already-narrow gap to Coal (margin 0.065) closes as Coal's mean-revert tag and mid-durability play out — retire this watch only if Coal's eligible-lead margin widens back above ~0.15 by the next detector read (i.e. the one-narrative reasserts).

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme with clear leadership and it is NOT crowded (z 0.78), so it is the least-bad expression of the dominant one-narrative structure. The lean rests on the trend-gate leg (eligible=true) plus the one-narrative/rotation leader leg, NOT on the momentum score itself (rank-IC ~0). Durability is only mid (0.54) and the hurst_tag is mean-revert, so this is a carry-under-a-cap, not a conviction buy.
evidence: rotation.leader = Coal with score 1.095 and margin 0.065 over challenger
theses.dissent: Coal is mean-revert-tagged (hurst_tag 'mean-revert') with breadth only 0.5 and durability_bar 0.54 — leadership could be a late cyclical squeeze that reverses hard in a mean-reverting A-share tape, and the trend gate has no drawdown edge here (gate_helps=false).

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only other eligible theme and show strong durability (0.78) and breadth (0.944), but they are crowded (z 1.74) and are already the crowded challenger behind a dominant one-narrative leader. Under the guardrails, crowding is a cap/size-down caution, not a fade — but for allocating fresh risk here, avoid is the honest lean given the crowded challenger structure.
evidence: rotation.challenger = Banks, margin only 0.065 behind Coal
theses.dissent: Banks are the durable trend (0.78 durability, 0.944 breadth) and arguably the healthier leadership candidate over mean-reverting Coal; avoiding them could miss the confirmed handoff if Coal rolls over.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS leads CSI 300 by 3% and Coal by 5% before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
